plugins.name: agentic-sdlc
plugins.description: Spec-driven, gate-enforced development lifecycle. Config Agent bootstraps deterministic checks; Spec Judge grills the PO until the spec is unambiguous and flags whether it needs a special architecture; an optional, human-invoked Architecture Judge can grill that design too; parallel build agents implement against a locked contract; a single verifier runs Security, Architecture, and QA as three independently-vetoable passes.
plugins.author: Agentic-First SDLC
